description_en: Retrieves the deployment and upgrade logs of a service instance
description_zh: 通过地域 ID、服务实例 ID等参数查询服务实例的部署和升级日志
kebab_example: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-70a3b15bb626435b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceInstanceLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this to the NextToken value that was returned in the last response
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The log source. Valid values:

computeNest (default): The deployment and upgrade logs of the service instance.

application: The logs generated by the application.

actionTrail: The ActionTrail audit logs.

ros: The ROS logs.

compliancePack: The compliance package logs
parameters.help_zh:
选择日志源。可选值：

computeNest（默认值）：服务实例部署、升级的日志。

application：应用产生的日志。

actionTrail: 操作审计日志

ros: ROS日志

compliancePack: 合规包日志
parameters.name: log_source

parameters.help_en: The Logstore. This parameter is required when you query application logs
parameters.help_zh:
Logstore信息。
查询应用日志时，需要指定Logstore
parameters.name: logstore

fields.help_en:
The filter name. You can query by one or more filter names. Valid values:

StartTime: Queries logs by the start time of the log event.

EndTime: Queries logs by the end time of the ActionTrail event.

EventName: Queries logs by the name of the ActionTrail event.

ResourceName: Queries logs by the ActionTrail resource name.

ApplicationGroupName: Queries logs by the application group name
fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

StartTime: 按日志事件的开始时间查询。
EndTime: 按ActionTrail事件的结束时间查询。
EventName: 按ActionTrail事件的名称查询。
ResourceName: 按ActionTrail资源名称查询。
ApplicationGroupName: 按应用程序组名称查询
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: A list of filter values. The value of N can be from 1 to 10
fields.help_zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Ascending: Ascending order.

Descending (default): Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
Ascending：升序
Descending（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query

CompliancePackType.description_en: The threat type of the compliance package. For example, VpcDataRisk indicates a data security check in a VPC
CompliancePackType.description_zh: 合规包风险类型。如VPC内数据安全检查，VpcDataRisk

ComplianceRuleName.description_en: The name of the specific threat rule in the compliance package. For example, ecs-move-out-vpc indicates the migration of an ECS instance out of a VPC
ComplianceRuleName.description_zh: 合规包具体风险规则名。如ECS实例迁移出VPC-ecs-move-out-vpc

LogType.description_en:
The log type. Valid values:

serviceInstance: The logs generated by the service instance.

resource: The logs generated by the ROS resource
LogType.description_zh:
日志类型。可能的值：
serviceInstance：服务实例产生的日志。

resource：ROS资源产生的日志

Source.description_en:
The source of the service instance log. Valid values:

computeNest: The deployment and upgrade logs of the service instance.

application: The logs generated by the application.

actionTrail: The ActionTrail audit logs.

ros: The ROS logs.

compliancePack: The compliance package logs
Source.description_zh:
服务实例日志的来源。可能的值：

computeNest：服务实例部署、升级的日志。

application：应用产生的日志。

actionTrail: 操作审计日志

ros： ROS日志

compliancePack: 合规包日志

Status.description_en:
The log status. Valid values:

Creating: The instance is being created.

Created: The instance is created.

Deploying: The instance is being deployed.

Deployed: The instance is deployed.

DeployedFailed: The deployment failed.

Expired: The instance has expired.

ExtendSuccess: The renewal is successful.

Upgrading: The instance is being upgraded.

UpgradeSuccess: The upgrade is successful
Status.description_zh:
日志状态。可能的值：

Creating：创建中。

Created：已创建。

Deploying：部署中。

Deployed：已部署。

DeployedFailed：部署失败。

Expired：已过期。

ExtendSuccess：续费成功。

Upgrading：升级中。

UpgradeSuccess：升级成功

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the service instance log
Timestamp.description_zh: 服务实例日志的时间戳
